Add PROMPT_HISTORY/<slug>.md and seed apps/<slug>/BUILD_STATE.json — its first field must be "slug": "<slug>" (the value you chose). Commit + push immediately as push-access proof.

tasks.title: Implement the app described in APP_DESCRIPTION, ONE FEATURE PER COMMIT/PUSH STEP, following the per-step protocol and quality constraints above.
